title: 第五章 聚气散
content_zh:
“咳。”白袍老者轻咳了一声，站起身来对着萧战拱了拱手，微笑道：“萧族长，此次前来贵家族，主要是有事相求”
“呵呵，葛叶先生，有事请说便是，如果力所能及，萧家应该不会推辞。”对于这位老者，萧战可不敢怠慢，连忙站起来客气的道，不过由于不知道对方到底所求何事，所以也不敢把话说得太满 。
“呵呵，萧族长，你可认识她么”葛叶微微一笑，指着身旁的少女含笑问道 。
“呃恕萧战眼拙，这位小姐”闻言，萧战一愣，上下打量了一下少女，略微有些尴尬的摇了摇头 。
当年纳兰嫣然被云韵收为弟子之时，年仅十岁，在云岚宗中修炼了五年时间，所谓女大十八变，好多年未见，萧战自然不知道面前的少女，便是自己名义上的儿媳妇 。
“咳她的名字叫纳兰嫣然。”
“纳兰嫣然纳兰老爷子的孙女纳兰嫣然”萧战先是一怔，紧接着满脸大喜，想必是记起了当年的那事，当下，急忙对着少女露出温和的笑容：“原来是纳兰侄女，萧叔叔可有好多年未曾与你见面了，可别怪罪叔叔眼拙。”
忽然出现的一幕，让得众人也是略微一愣，三位长老互相对视了一眼，眉头不由得皱了皱
“萧叔叔，侄女一直未曾前来拜见，该赔罪的，可是我呢，哪敢怪罪萧叔叔。”纳兰嫣然甜甜的笑道 。
“呵呵，纳兰侄女，以前便听说了你被云韵大人收入门下，当时还以为是流言，没想到，竟然是真的，侄女真是好天赋啊”萧战笑着赞叹道 。
“嫣然只是好运罢了”浅浅一笑，纳兰嫣然有些吃不消萧战的热情，桌下的手掌，轻轻扯了扯身旁的葛叶 。
“呵呵，萧族长，在下今日所请求之事，便与嫣然有关，而且此事，还是宗主大人亲自开口”葛叶轻笑了一声，在提到宗主二字时，脸庞上的表情，略微郑重 。
脸色微微一变，萧战也是收敛了笑容，云岚宗宗主云韵可是加玛帝国的大人物，他这小小的一族之长，可是半点都遭惹不起，可以她的实力与势力，又有何事需要萧家帮忙葛叶说是与纳兰侄女有关，难道
想到某种可能，萧战的嘴角忍不住的抽搐了几下，硕大的手掌微微颤抖，不过好在有着袖子的遮掩，所以也未曾被发现，强行压下心头的怒火，声音有些发颤的凝声道：“葛叶先生，请说”
“咳”葛叶脸色忽然出现了一抹尴尬，不过想起宗主对纳兰嫣然的疼爱，又只得咬了咬牙，笑道：“萧族长，您也知道，云岚宗门风严厉，而且宗主大人对嫣然的期望也是很高，现在基本上已经是把她当做云岚宗下一任的宗主在培养而因为一些特殊的规矩，宗主传人在未成为正式宗主之前，都不可与男子有纠葛”
“宗主大人在询问过嫣然之后，知道她与萧家还有一门亲事，所以所以宗主大人想请萧族长，能够解除了这婚约。”
“咔”萧战手中的玉石杯，轰然间化为了一蓬粉末 。
大厅之中，气氛有些寂静，上方的三位长老也是被葛叶的话震了了震，不过片刻之后，他们望向萧战的目光中，已经多出了一抹讥讽与嘲笑 。
“嘿嘿，被人上门强行解除婚约，看你这族长，以后还有什么威望管理家族”
一些年轻一辈的少年少女并不知晓萧炎与纳兰嫣然的婚约，不过在向身旁的父母打听了一下之后，他们的脸色，顿时变得精彩了起来，讥诮的嘲讽目光，投向了角落处的萧炎

望着萧战那阴沉至极的脸色，纳兰嫣然也是不敢抬头，将头埋下，手指紧张的绞在了一起 。
“萧族长，我知道这要求有些强人所难，不过还请看在宗主大人的面上，解除了婚约吧”无奈的叹了一口气，葛叶淡淡的道 。
萧战拳头紧握，淡淡的青色斗气，逐渐的覆盖了身躯，最后竟然隐隐约约的在脸庞处汇聚成了一个虚幻的狮头 。
萧家顶级功法：狂狮怒罡等级：玄阶中级
望着萧战的反映，葛叶脸庞也顿时凝重了起来，身体挡在纳兰嫣然身前，鹰爪般的双手猛的曲拢，青色斗气在鹰爪中汇聚而起，散发着细小而凌厉的剑气 。
云岚宗高深功法，青木剑诀等级：玄阶低级
随着两人气息的喷发，大厅之中，实力较弱的少年们，脸色猛的一白，旋即胸口有些发闷 。
就在萧战的呼吸越加急促之声，三位长老的厉喝声，却是宛如惊雷般的在大厅中响起：“萧战，还不住手你可不要忘记，你是萧家的族长”
身子猛的一僵，萧战身体上的斗气缓缓的收敛，最后完全消失 。
一屁股坐回椅子上，萧战脸色淡漠的望着低头不言的纳兰嫣然，声音有些嘶哑的道：“纳兰侄女呐，好魄力啊，纳兰肃有你这女儿，真是很让人羡慕啊”
娇躯微微一颤，纳兰嫣然呐呐的道：“萧叔叔”
“呵呵，叫我萧族长就好，叔叔这称谓，我担不起，你是未来云岚宗的宗主，日后也是斗气大陆的风云人物，我家炎儿不过是资质平庸之辈，也的确是配不上你”淡淡的挥了挥手，萧战语气冷漠的道 。
“多谢萧族长体谅了。”闻言，一旁的葛叶大喜，对着萧战赔笑道:“萧族长，宗主大人知道今天这要求很是有些不礼貌，所以特地让在下带来一物，就当做是赔礼”
说着，葛叶伸手抹了抹手指上的一枚戒指，一只通体泛绿的古玉盒子在手中凭空出现
三位长老好奇的伸过头，望着玉匣子内，身体猛的一震，惊声道：“聚气散”
content_en:
"Ahem." The old man in white robe coughed lightly, stood up, cupped his hands towards Xiao Zhan, and said with a smile: "Chief Xiao, I came to your family this time mainly because I have something to ask for."
"Haha, Mr. Ge Ye, please tell me if you have anything to say. If it is within our ability, the Xiao family will not refuse." Xiao Zhan did not dare to neglect this old man, and stood up and said politely. However, because he did not know what the other party wanted, he did not dare to speak too fully.
"Haha, Chief Xiao, do you know her?" Ge Ye smiled slightly, pointed at the girl beside him and asked with a smile.
"Uh, forgive Xiao Zhan for his poor eyesight, this lady." Hearing this, Xiao Zhan was startled, looked the girl up and down, and shook his head in embarrassment.
When Nalan Yanran was accepted as a disciple by Yun Yun, she was only ten years old and had been practicing in Yunlan Sect for five years. She had not seen the so-called eighteenth transformation of a girl for many years. Naturally, Xiao Zhan didn't know that the girl in front of him was his nominal daughter-in-law.
"Ahem, her name is Nalan Yanran."
"Nalan Yanran, Mr. Nalan's granddaughter Nalan Yanran." Xiao Zhan was startled at first, and then his face was full of joy. He must have remembered what happened back then. At that moment, he hurriedly showed a gentle smile to the girl: "It turns out that she is Nalan's niece. Uncle Xiao has not seen you for many years, so don't blame uncle for his poor eyesight."
The scene that suddenly appeared made everyone slightly stunned. The three elders looked at each other and frowned involuntarily.
"Uncle Xiao, my niece has never come to see her, so she should apologize, but how can I dare to blame Uncle Xiao." Nalan Yanran said with a sweet smile.
"Haha, niece Nalan, I have heard before that you were taken into the sect of Master Yun Yun. I thought it was a rumor at the time, but unexpectedly, it turned out to be true. My niece is really talented," Xiao Zhan praised with a smile.
"Yanran is just lucky." With a faint smile, Nalan Yanran couldn't stand Xiao Zhan's enthusiasm. She gently pulled the kudzu leaf beside her with her palm under the table.
"Haha, Chief Xiao, what I am requesting today is related to Yan Ran, and the sect leader himself spoke about it." Ge Ye chuckled lightly, and when he mentioned the word sect leader, the expression on his face was slightly solemn.
His face changed slightly, and Xiao Zhan also suppressed his smile. Yun Yun, the leader of the Yunlan Sect, was a big shot in the Jiama Empire. He, the head of a small clan, could not afford to be offended at all. But with her strength and power, why did the Xiao family need help? Ge Ye said it was related to Nalan's niece. Could it be
Thinking of a certain possibility, Xiao Zhan couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth a few times, and his huge palms trembled slightly, but fortunately they were covered by his sleeves, so they were not discovered. He suppressed the anger in his heart and said in a trembling voice: "Mr. Kuzu Ye, please tell me."
"Ahem" Ge Ye's face suddenly showed a hint of embarrassment, but remembering the sect leader's love for Nalan Yanran, he could only grit his teeth and said with a smile: "Clan Chief Xiao, you also know that the Yunlan Sect has a strict family style, and the sect leader treats Yanran Ran's expectations are also very high, and now she is basically being trained as the next sect leader of the Yunlan Sect. Due to some special rules, the sect leader's successors are not allowed to have entanglements with men before they become the official sect leader."
"After asking about Yanran, the lord of the sect learned that she has a marriage relationship with the Xiao family, so the lord of the sect wants to ask the Xiao clan leader to dissolve the engagement."
"Click" The jade cup in Xiao Zhan's hand suddenly turned into a puff of powder.
In the hall, the atmosphere was somewhat silent. The three elders above were also shocked by Kuzu Ye's words. However, after a moment, there was a touch of sarcasm and ridicule in their eyes when they looked at Xiao Zhan.
"Hey, someone came to your door and forcibly broke off the engagement. Let's see how much prestige you, the patriarch, will have in managing the family in the future."
Some young girls and boys of the younger generation are not aware of the engagement between Xiao Yan and Nalan Yanran, but they are asking about it.After the parents next to them inquired about it, their expressions suddenly became brighter, and they cast sarcastic and mocking glances at Xiao Yan in the corner.
Looking at Xiao Zhan's extremely gloomy face, Nalan Yanran did not dare to raise her head, buried her head, and twisted her fingers together nervously.
"Clan Chief Xiao, I know this request is a bit too much, but for the sake of the sect leader, please cancel the engagement." Ge Ye sighed helplessly and said lightly.
Xiao Zhan clenched his fists, and a faint cyan fighting spirit gradually covered his body, and finally vaguely gathered on his face to form an illusory lion head.
Xiao family's top skill: Wild Lion Fury Gang Level: Intermediate Xuan level
Looking at Xiao Zhan's reaction, Ge Ye's face suddenly became solemn, and he blocked Nalan Yanran's body. His hands like eagle claws suddenly curled up, and green fighting energy gathered in the eagle claws, exuding a small and sharp sword energy.
Yunlan Sect's advanced skills, Qingmu Sword Technique Level: Xuan level low level
As the breath of the two people erupted, the faces of the weaker teenagers in the hall suddenly turned pale, and their chests immediately felt a little tight.
Just as Xiao Zhan's breathing became more rapid, the sharp shouts of the three elders sounded like thunder in the hall: "Xiao Zhan, if you don't stop, don't forget that you are the patriarch of the Xiao family."
His body suddenly stiffened, and the fighting spirit in Xiao Zhan's body slowly converged, and finally disappeared completely.
Sitting back on the chair, Xiao Zhan looked at Nalan Yanran with an indifferent expression and said in a hoarse voice: "Niece Nalan, you are so courageous. Nalan Su has a daughter like you, I am really enviable."
Her delicate body trembled slightly, and Nalan Yanran said: "Uncle Xiao"
"Haha, just call me Patriarch Xiao. I can't bear the title of uncle. You will be the future leader of the Yunlan Sect, and you will also be a prominent figure in the Dou Qi Continent in the future. My Yan'er is just a person with mediocre qualifications, and is indeed not worthy of you." He waved his hand lightly, and Xiao Zhan said in an indifferent tone.
"Thank you Patriarch Xiao for your understanding." Hearing this, Ge Ye was overjoyed and smiled apologetically at Xiao Zhan: "Chief Xiao, the sect leader knows that today's request is very impolite, so I specially asked me to bring something as an apology."
As he spoke, Kuzu Ye reached out and wiped a ring on his finger, and a green ancient jade box appeared out of thin air in his hand.
The three elders stretched their heads curiously and looked into the jade box. Their bodies shook violently and they said in shock: "Qi Gathering Powder"
